_noteQ: Q (Radiant Volley) FIXED -- was critically undercounting. BIN MelQAbility/MelQ has TWO damage components on a single cast: InitialExplosionDamage (NDV(InitialDamage)+0.55AP, real ranks 60/85/110/135/160) for the first impact, and TotalExplosionDamage (NDV(ExplosionDamage)+0.05AP, real ranks 5/7/9/11/13) per SUBSEQUENT explosion, of which there are ExplosionCount total bolts (real ranks 6/7/8/9/10, i.e. 1 initial + 5/6/7/8/9 subsequent). Confirmed via live wiki fetch: 'Initial Explosion: 60/85/110/135/160 (+55% AP)', 'Subsequent Explosions: 5/7/9/11/13 (+5% AP)', '6/7/8/9/10 bolts total', and a 'Total Combined' line (85/127/173/223/277, +80-100% AP) that arithmetically equals InitialExplosionDamage + TotalExplosionDamage*(bolts-1) at every rank -- matching the BIN's own tooltipOnly 'AllDamageHit' aggregate calc exactly. The prior curation used ONLY TotalExplosionDamage with count 1, i.e. modeled a single small subsequent-explosion tick and completely omitted the much larger initial hit and the multi-bolt nature of the ability. FIXED to two hits: InitialExplosionDamage (count 1) + TotalExplosionDamage (count 5, the rank-1/minimum subsequent-bolt count, a deliberate conservative floor since this engine's count field cannot scale by rank -- real subsequent-bolt count grows to 9 at rank 5, so this UNDERcounts at higher ranks by design rather than guessing an overcount).
_noteW: W (Rebuttal) shield/reflect mechanic re-examined and CORRECTED to genuinely-blocked (was wrongly curated as a direct magic damage hit). BIN MelWAbility/MelW's only damage-shaped calc is 'DamagePercent' (NDV(BaseDamagePercent, 35-65%) + StatByCoefficient 0.0005, mDisplayAsPercent:true) -- confirmed via live wiki fetch this is NOT a flat damage amount but a REFLECT PERCENTAGE applied to incoming projectile damage the shield blocks: 'Magic damage projectiles: 40/45/50/55/60% (+5% per 100 AP) of the original damage' and 'Physical damage projectiles: 28/31.5/35/38.5/42% (+3.5% per 100 AP) of the original damage'. The prior curation fed this 0.35-0.65 percentage straight into a flat magic-damage hit slot, producing a near-zero garbage value (a genuine bug, not a rounding issue). The real damage is conditional on an incoming attack this engine does not simulate (P2: no inference beyond Last Seen) -- correctly left with no hits, same class as other reflect/conditional mechanics. ShieldAmount (NDV(BaseShieldAmount)+0.7AP, matches wiki shield '80/110/140/170/200 (+70% AP)') is a shield value, not damage, and is out of this schema's scope.
_noteE: E (Solar Snare): direct impact 'Damage' (NDV(BaseDamage)+0.7AP, real ranks 60/105/150/195/240) matches wiki 'Direct Impact Damage: 60/105/150/195/240 (+70% AP)'. The 'AreaDamagePerSecond' orb-proximity DoT (NDV(BaseAreaDamage)+0.08AP flat StatByNamedDataValue, real ranks 16/28/40/52/64) matches wiki 'Lingering Field Damage: 16/28/40/52/64 (+8% AP) per second'. EXPOSURE CORRECTED (empirical, user-measured this pass): a stationary 0-armour dummy directly hit by rank-1 E takes 74-78 total (direct 66 + DoT, with early-game AP giving ~17/s), i.e. ~0.5-0.75s of DoT (~2-3 ticks at a 0.25s cadence), NOT the full 1.5s snare root. The 'lingering field' is really the moving orb's proximity, so a single caught target's exposure is bounded by how long the orb dwells over it, which is why the total varies with E angle. Because the impact ROOTS the target, that short window is GUARANTEED (not escapable): guaranteedSeconds 0.5 (the floor the target cannot avoid -> resolved/RangeMin includes the DoT) and maxDurationSeconds 0.75 (the angle-dependent ceiling the exposure knob can raise it to). The prior 1.5s = RootDuration assumption overcounted the ceiling to ~91; the field's real dwell is shorter than the root it applies. Tagged Zone.
_noteR: R (Golden Eclipse) FIXED -- was using the WRONG calc entirely. The prior curation picked 'PassiveStackDamage' (NDV(BasePassiveStackDamage)+0.75%AP), which BIN's own tooltip metadata (nameOverride 'Spell_MelR_PassiveStackDamage') and a live wiki fetch confirm belongs to R's PASSIVE Overwhelm-stack-storage upgrade ('Overwhelm stacks store more damage... Stored Damage Increase per Stack: 1/2/3'), NOT to the active ultimate cast -- a completely different mechanic that happens to live on the same BIN spell node. The real active-cast damage is 'UltFlatDamage' (NDV(BaseUltFlatDamage)+0.3AP, real 3 ranks 125/200/275) plus 'UltStackDamage' (NDV(BaseUltStackDamage)+0.04AP, real 3 ranks 4/7/10) per Overwhelm stack already on the target -- confirmed via live wiki fetch: 'Magic Damage: 125/200/275 (+30% AP) (+4/7/10 (+4% AP) per Overwhelm stack on the target)', matching both calcs exactly. FIXED to two hits: UltFlatDamage (count 1) + UltStackDamage (count 3 -- this engine cannot track live Overwhelm stack count, so 3 is used as a documented conservative approximation, directly matching the BIN's OWN bot-AI aggregate formula for this spell, 'UltFlatDamage + UltStackDamage*3', found in MelR's BotData). The passive stack-storage upgrade (PassiveFlatDamage/PassiveStackDamage) remains genuinely uncurated -- it only modifies how much damage a LIVE Overwhelm stack stores for later, unrelated to any hit dealt here (P2, no live buff-stack feed, same infeasible class as other champions' stack-storage-only passives).
